101: 			}
102: 
103: 			if ip != "" {
104: 				log.Debug().Msgf("discovered IP address: %v", ip)
105: 
106: 				cmd := p.Settings.Daemon.StartCoreDNS()
107: 				go func() {
108: 					_ = cmd.Run()
109: 				}()
110: 
111: 				if err := p.Settings.Daemon.DNS.Set(ip); err != nil {
112: 					return fmt.Errorf("error setting daemon dns: %w", err)
113: 				}
114: 			}

116: 
117: 		cmd := p.Settings.Daemon.Start()
118: 		go func() {
119: 			_ = cmd.Run()
120: 		}()
121: 	}
122: 
123: 	// poll the docker daemon until it is started. This ensures the daemon is
124: 	// ready to accept connections before we proceed.
125: 	for i := 0; i < 15; i++ {
126: 		cmd := docker.Info()
127: 
128: 		err := cmd.Run()
129: 		if err == nil {
130: 			break
131: 		}

144: 		}
145: 	}

148: 		if err := p.Settings.Registry.Login().Run(); err != nil {
149: 			return fmt.Errorf("error authenticating: %w", err)
150: 		}
151: 	}
152: 
153: 	buildkitConf := p.Settings.BuildkitConfig
154: 	if buildkitConf != "" {
155: 		if p.Settings.Daemon.BuildkitConfigFile, err = plugin_file.WriteTmpFile("buildkit.toml", buildkitConf); err != nil {
156: 			return fmt.Errorf("error writing buildkit config: %w", err)
157: 		}
158: 
159: 		defer os.Remove(p.Settings.Daemon.BuildkitConfigFile)
160: 	}
161:

165: 	case p.Settings.Registry.Config != "":

169: 	}

172:

174: 	bf.InitialInterval = daemonBackoffInitialInterval
175: 	bf.Multiplier = daemonBackoffMultiplier
176: 
177: 	bfo := func() (any, error) {
178: 		return nil, docker.Version().Run()

180:

183: 	}

188: 		backoff.WithNotify(bfn))
